data_sources.text: SPHEREx DR1 Level-2 spectral images, read in the browser from NASA's public archive copy on AWS (no server, no IRSA services). Our index covers 1,179,406 pictures.
Spitzer and Hubble measurements of WISE 0855−0714, as published by Luhman & Esplin (2016): its predicted path and its 4.5 µm brightness.
JPL Horizons, with SPHEREx as the observer (500@-163182): predicted asteroid positions.
JPL Small-Body Database: H magnitudes, orbits, and reference diameters from NEOWISE, IRAS and AKARI (asteroid pages only).
NEOWISE diameters and albedos (Planetary Data System).
ESA Gaia DR3 stars (for the pixel model and the motions of Epsilon Indi B and Barnard's Star) and asteroid reflectance spectra, via the AIP mirror.
CDS SIMBAD: positions and motions of the five test targets (from Gaia DR3, Kirkpatrick et al. 2021 for WISE 0855 in the live view, and van Leeuwen 2007 for RW Aurigae).
